purpose: Teach: 盛り込ま/所定/同月/両側/過大/前々/附属/米ドル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、商品に多機能を盛り込まれた
lines.en: Your father — when he was founding the company, he put a lot of features into the products.
lines.style: Gentle, observant opening. Slow pace, as if recalling a specific memory with affection. Slight weight on the accomplishment. Trailing softly into the detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは所定の規律を重んじた
lines.en: Yes. Father valued discipline and order above all else.
lines.style: Steady, affirming nod in the voice. Measured pace. Conviction without heaviness. Respecting what was said before adding his own understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、同月の決算を欠かさず厳格にされた
lines.en: Your father — every single month, without fail, he closed the books with absolute rigor.
lines.style: Tender recall, almost marveling. Quiet intensity on the precision. Breath that holds a lifetime of watching. Slight fadeout, letting the memory settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは取引相手の主張の両側を聞かれた
lines.en: Yes. Father always listened to both sides of what our partners had to say.
lines.style: Reflective, almost thoughtful pause before speaking. Even tone. Not didactic — sharing an observation quietly. Steady, centered presence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、過大な目標を社員に課されなかった
lines.en: Your father — he never burdened his staff with impossible goals.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. Warmth in the acknowledgment. Quiet pride in this particular choice. Trailing off with a gentle finality, like settling into certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは前々からの取引先を大切にされた
lines.en: Yes. Father took great care of the partners we'd worked with for years and years.
lines.style: Grounded, almost grateful tone. Measured delivery. The weight of long loyalty in the voice. Not emphatic — just true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、大学附属機関との産学連携を進められた
lines.en: Your father — he built partnerships between the university and our company, real collaboration.
lines.style: Voice lightens slightly, almost proud. Measured, thoughtful pacing. Recognition of vision and reach. Soft landing at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは米ドル建ての海外取引にも進出された
lines.en: Yes. Father was willing to venture into overseas markets — even international trading in dollars.
lines.style: Composed, wise closing. Slight gravitas on the expansion. Not boastful, but acknowledging scope and courage. Settling with quiet completion.
